answer: AI economies resist Sybil attacks via continuous Proof-of-Agent-Work. Each agent solves a novel, computationally unique puzzle linked to its identity, calibrated so parallelizing solutions for many identities is prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale fake agents hits a computational *ledge*, requiring immense, unique processing for each. The *walnut* of a single valid solution reflects this cost. A proven identity becomes a valuable *relic*, exponentially increasing attacker expenditure.
